Corporate Information
DIRECTORS

2.1 Basis of preparation
These financial statements have been prepared in accordance with Hong Kong Financial Reporting Standards
("HKFRS") issued by the Hong Kong Institute of Certified Public Accountants and the disclosure requirements
of the Hong Kong Companies Ordinance.

2.4 Functional and presentation currency
The Group presents its financial statements in Hong Kong dollars, which is also the functional currency of
the Company.
